game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry, a glassy black quarry: the forge smith must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Rounding Range: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry: a glassy black quarry
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read n. Display Above when n > -2; otherwise display At or below. Test dataset 3: {'n': -4}; {'n': 1}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rounding Range' (Week 2 slot 13), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Obsidian Quarry'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ember furnace by solving code steps involving slot_matches that move the forge smith forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the ember furnace first, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
